how.key_use: Send "Authorization: Bearer <key>" with POST https://api.example.com/v1/tasks {"title", "step", "urgency"} to ask this person one thing; GET /v1/tasks/{task_id} reads the reply. That is all this key does.
how.link_use: Or POST the same body to the link, and GET <link>/<task_id> for the reply: for an AI that can only call an address.

step_examples.text: Someone is at the front door. Let them in?
